annotations.text:
AVATAR (from 10xecom.ca): complete beginners - shift workers and newcomers to North America. Building alongside a job, on a tight budget. Wary of scams. Taught by someone who worked shifts and carried debt.

Site promise: "Build your Shopify business without quitting your job."
Site disclaimer: "NO INCOME GUARANTEES. THIS IS A REAL BUSINESS THAT TAKES REAL WORK."

WARNING - posts 02 to 05 are aimed at the WRONG PERSON.

AOV / CAC / LTV and "it's not traffic, it's math" were written for experienced operators. A complete beginner working shifts does not know those acronyms and will read them as "not for me" - the exact opposite of what an audience filter should do for this launch.

Post 01 (the redaction) still works: it says nothing about who it is for.

06 is rebuilt on the real avatar and is safe to post.

06 keeps the payoff structure: story 01's voice, then the name where the redaction bars were.

The promise is the site's own line, with the emotional half in the accent.

The disclaimer is on the image deliberately - this audience is targeted by scams, so saying "no income guarantees" out loud is a trust asset, not a legal chore.

DM keyword is 10X. Set up an auto-reply before posting, and route it to the free strategy call.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.

The band above each CTA is deliberate sticker room.
